name: St. Johns County, FL
findings: St. Johns County has 912 nonprofit organizations. 357 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 274 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Johns County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 68 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 68 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few youth organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 youth organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through youth groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Johns County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
